commits.messageBody:
Check the size once before emitting either legacy length header, then use the checked unsigned count for ByteStream::put. This removes the later implicit size_t narrowing without changing representable wire encodings.

Validation: existing wire fixtures pass 19/19 with -m32 and 20/20 with -m64, including the 65534/65535 string boundary. No claim of nested serialization rollback or full server acceptance.
(cherry picked from commit 28f43f686d4ac81338a4b097d2f1726ae20e8f38)
commits.messageHeadline: archive: reuse checked string length for the payload write

commits.messageBody:
Reject reads and advances beyond logical data, preflight append arithmetic, and retain old storage until allocation/copy completes. Keep shared storage intact during detach/reserve and valid self-append. Pool insertion failure releases its lock and deletes optional cached storage. Preserve public server widths and wire bytes; bound-stream zero-byte reads consistently succeed.

Validation:85 small initialized-storage checks on each Linux ABI; existing wire19/19 (-m32),20/20 (-m64). Mirror of independently reviewed client algorithm. This does not validate raw-pointer decoders before their reads, general iterator invalidation, nested delta rollback, concurrent stream access or full-server acceptance.
(cherry picked from commit 7131fd38806b53774cb25ae68fcf5c55789c85fd)
commits.messageHeadline: archive: bound ByteStream access and publish storage after copying

commits.messageBody:
Reject declared payloads exceeding remaining input before touching the destination. Decode Unicode via a checked byte copy into aligned owned code units, avoiding typed reads from unaligned packet storage. Keep valid wire bytes and header-consumed rejection behavior; this is not outer-message rollback.

Matching client candidate passes34 focused checks on both portable ABIs and four native v120/STLport configurations; parent independently ran34 on this server fork with -m32/-m64. No malformed-input run on old code, huge allocation or allocation-failure injection.

(cherry picked from commit 5474d3d0920ef33f8fef7d0acdda490c8c40c453)
commits.messageHeadline: archive: preflight string and stream payloads before copying

commits.messageBody:
Use the existing unsigned32 count helper before writing either header. Ordinary 0/1/3-element legacy bytes and full decode consumption pass in client/server tests, and the client fixtures pass on stock Win32. Oversized rejection at the actual container call sites is source-reviewed, not claimed runtime tested.

(cherry picked from commit 2648217a654cfa5e7beb3f95498cb8f534d043ea)
commits.messageHeadline: archive: check ordinary array and list counts before serialization

commits.messageBody:
After checking the legacy unsigned code-unit count, reject counts whose multiplied byte size cannot fit ByteStream's unsigned byte argument. Divide before multiplying, then publish the unchanged unsigned count and bounded payload length.

Extracted arithmetic checks pass6/6 on both host ABIs; client real wire fixtures pass71/78. Oversized actual strings were not allocated or claimed tested. Aggregate buffer capacity and nested rollback remain separate; this guards count rejection before the header.

(cherry picked from commit c6cdbe85d301aecd5e3e443e246baf3dbb84e8f3)
commits.messageHeadline: archive: bound Unicode payload bytes before writing a header

commits.messageBody:
Replace the two noncopying server auto_ptr guards with unique_ptr. Both retain the same cleanup and release points; old backing storage remains alive until a self-source copy completes. The legacy v120/STLport client keeps its compatible guard.

C++17 with deprecated declarations treated as errors passes 85 bounded initialized-storage checks on both Linux ABIs. Existing wire fixtures pass 19/19 (-m32) and 20/20 (-m64). Tests use libstdc++; a full libc++ server build is not claimed.

(cherry picked from commit 731d85cc10326f5f2d656b4b66f09c5feab30635)
